name: complete-task
description: Complete the benchmark, paper, and evaluation data for a single Papers With Code task page end-to-end, using the legacy PwC dump as the source of truth for what the major benchmarks and papers are. Use this whenever the user wants to "complete", "fill out", "build out", "populate", "flesh out", "round out", or "finish" a task page; audit a task for missing benchmarks/evals; or says things like "make the motion-generation task complete", "add the top benchmarks and papers for object tracking", "populate evals for this task", or "bring the <task> leaderboards up to date". It mines the legacy evaluation-tables.json for the top benchmarks (by leaderboard entries) and their top papers, then orchestrates the add-benchmark, enrich-paper, add-evals, and verify-evals skills (one focused subagent each) to index papers, create missing benchmarks, import evaluations, and verify every leaderboard is apples-to-apples. Prefer this orchestration skill over running those skills ad hoc when the goal is whole-task completion rather than a single benchmark/paper/eval. When data already exists, it degrades gracefully into verifying what is there. Be memory-aware: the legacy dump is ~250 MB and this runs on a small VPS, so always stream it with the bundled miner rather than loading it.

findings.excerpt: uv run --env-file backend/keys.env pwc paper index "$ARXIV_ID" --json
